text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] routing-error detected: multiple requests to /v1/chat.stream are being routed to gen-variant (v3.4) which is incompatible with chat schema. Possible pinned model mismatch. Paging @oncall-elena :rotating_light:

oncall-elena: on it. Priority?

incident-bot: Severity: P2. Errors spike 09:02 UTC, retries increasing, some customers reporting malformed chat responses or embeddings endpoint returning long-form text.

sre-mike: seeing lots of 409/variant-mismatch in router logs, plus a surge of fallback retries to region-us-west-2 and then to fallback-dedicated. looks like routing policy is cascading. logs:```
# /srv/router/logs tail
[09:02:13] request id=abc123 route=/v1/chat model_pin=redwood-chat-instruct:2.0 -> selected model=redwood-gen-3.4
[09:02:13] error variant_mismatch: endpoint expects chat but model supports gen
[09:02:14] fallback->region us-west-2
[09:02:15] fallback->dedicated-pool-3
```

mlops-joy: quick context: we recently pinned redwood-chat-instruct:2.0 in the customer-policy for account ACCT-998. But model registry update this morning renamed variants; there was a version bump that created two separate families (chat-instruct and gen) and one of the alias mappings got flipped.

eng-runtime-rahul: can we hotfix router policy to short-circuit variant compatibility check -> prefer same-architecture variants? or temporarily disable cross-variant fallback?

oncall-elena: immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop cascading cross-variant fallbacks (router config toggle) 2) unpin policy for ACCT-998 to let requests use default routing 3) patch alias mapping in model-registry to correct pin -> chat-instruct. Doing step 1 now.

product-sam: heads up: customer Ops says 2 enterprise customers reporting bad outputs in prod chat integrations. possible SLA impact.

customer-ops-liz: confirming: Customer "AcmeDocs" ticket #2345 — their chat returned paragraphs of prose instead of structured answers. They rate-limited due to downstream parsing failures. They are on Dedicated.

eng-runtime-rahul: toggled config: `router.allow_cross_variant_fallback=false` on global router. rolling out to 3 nodes.

incident-bot: deploy initiated by rahul (cfg-987). 3 nodes updated, 4 remaining.

sre-mike: nodes 1-3 updated, seeing immediate drop in variant_mismatch errors. but a small queue backlog formed while we drained in-flight requests. watching latency.

mlops-joy: while rahul patches registry mapping, I can unpin the customer policy for ACCT-998 as a stopgap. Doing that now via infra CLI.```

mlops-joy: CLI: `redwood policy update --account ACCT-998 --unset model_pin` -> accepted.

incident-bot: policy update recorded. Requests for ACCT-998 will now route using regular selection logic (should pick chat-instruct family where compatible).

oncall-elena: after unpin, I'm seeing new requests route to `redwood-chat-instruct:2.1` (auto-selected). good.

product-sam: can we confirm no token leakage or data mixup? customers worried about privacy.

sre-mike: no cross-account data in logs. requests were only misrouted to wrong variant, not wrong tenant. double-checked headers and tenant ids.

eng-runtime-rahul: registry patch applied: alias `redwood-chat-instruct:latest` now points correctly. Also pushed a validation that prevents alias pointing to different architecture families. PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/418

mlops-joy: rolling back pin change for ACCT-998 is in audit log. We'll keep it unpinned until next maintenance window and then re-pin to `redwood-chat-instruct:2.1` explicitly.

customer-ops-liz: I updated AcmeDocs with status: mitigation applied, working with eng. They acknowledged and paused escalations.

oncall-elena: next: follow-up tasks -- (a) add alert for variant_mismatch rate > 10/min (b) add canary for policy alias renames (c) postmortem if customer impact > 15m. I'm documenting in incident channel.

incident-bot: handoff reminder: oncall-elena to handoff to oncall-sam in 1h.

eng-runtime-rahul: note — we should also tighten smart-routing rules to prefer model capability checks before applying pin fallbacks. Adding a short-term rule: `if model.pin exists and variant incompatible -> failover to same-family variant only`. will PR today.

mlops-joy: verified metrics: variant_mismatch errors peaked at 09:02:20 with 124 events, reduced to <2 after config toggle at 09:05. customer-visible errors ~11 min window.

product-sam: marking incident as sev2 but will re-evaluate after impact window. please add timeline to postmortem.

oncall-elena: handoff to @oncall-sam done (virtual). leaving notes in #incidents.

sre-mike: final checks: latency normalized, no backlog. I'll keep extra alerting for 30m.

mlops-joy: post-incident next steps: 1) backfill missing integration tests for pin-to-variant mapping, 2) deploy registry alias validation as blue/green, 3) update runbook to include immediate unpin step.

customer-ops-liz: AcmeDocs confirmed they resumed traffic at 09:28 and saw normal behavior.

oncall-elena: resolution: unpin + router toggle + registry alias patch. closing on-call loop. Will file postmortem and link ticket.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] routing-error resolved at 09:30 UTC. Incident duration ~28m.

sre-mike: thanks team. good catch.

product-sam: please include customer communication copy in the postmortem.

eng-runtime-rahul: PR for stricter routing checks: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pull/502 (includes tests).

mlops-joy: creating postmortem draft and timeline. assigning owners for each action.

oncall-elena: handing off final notes to next oncall. good job everyone :thumbsup:
